description: This header file declares functions and includes necessary headers for broadcasting property set and delete events in a system that manages properties. It provides function prototypes for starting and stopping an event producer and broadcasting property events to listeners.

methods.name: startPropsEventProducer
methods.description: Initializes the event producer to start broadcasting property events.

methods.name: broadcastPropertyEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts a property change event (add, delete, update) to listeners with relevant details.
